sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Goldblaze is a secondary weapon in Phantom Blade Zero. Reward for Quick Hand's Request at Zhang's Hideout in Pangzhen, which means it is tied to the Lost and Found trophy.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Goldblaze occupies the Secondary (Phantom Edge) slot, and it is classed as Not stated in the source list. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the Phantom Edge index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. No verified note on how this weapon behaves inside a combo has been published, so nothing is written here.
